title: Feasibility and Clinical Utility of Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) in Identifying Actionable Alterations and Minimal Residual Disease for Lymphoma Patients Across Community Centers in Texas
official: Feasibility and Clinical Utility of Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) in Identifying Actionable Alterations and Minimal Residual Disease for Lymphoma Patients Across Community Centers in Texas
summary: To test the feasibility of collecting cell-free DNA (cfDNA) samples from DLBCL patients before and after treatment. cfDNA is DNA traveling in your blood outside of a cell and is easily collected from blood samples drawn using the vein puncture method.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Male/female patients who are at least 18 years of age on the day of informed consent signing.
2. Patients must have a histologically documented diffuse large B-cell lymphoma requiring therapy.
3. Provision of written informed consent for the study.
4. Pregnant women not included
5. Cognitively impaired adults are not included.

Exclusion Criteria:

None
